close_reason: Decision: generic S: AsRef<str> is correct and ergonomic. No code change needed.
description: Generalizing from &[&str] to &[S] where S: AsRef<str> is the correct API design. It lets callers pass &[String] (e.g., Vec<String> of capabilities loaded from config at startup) without requiring .as_str() conversions or &strs lifetime-pinned to temporaries. A future contributor might suggest reverting to &[&str] for 'simplicity'. Reject that: the generic version is strictly more usable with zero performance cost and identical semantics.
title: check_known_capabilities generic S: AsRef<str> — correct and should be defended
